metric_name: Distribution of OFWs by major occupation group
population_scope: OFWs who departed October 2019-September 2024 and worked abroad April-September 2024; families still residing in the Philippines; both sexes
source_table: SOF 2024 Table 2; Tab 2!C20:F29; OFWs, both sexes
confidence_reasons: Sample-survey estimate. | Sampling error published by the source. | PSA cautions: coefficient of variation above 10%; use with caution.
notes: Transformed and published. Publisher's percentage divided by 100; not recomputed from counts or renormalised. PSOC version: SOF 2024 Technical Notes p.2, limitation 5. Blank armed-forces percentage stays missing despite zero precision cells. https://psa.gov.ph/system/files/iesd/SOF-2024-Technical-Notes.pdf PSA cautions that CV above 10% may be unreliable due to few observations. Common misreading to avoid: This is P(occupation | OFW). It is NOT the share of workers in an occupation who are OFWs, P(OFW | occupation) — that needs domestic employment in the same occupation as its denominator and a compatible universe. The two are not interchangeable.
